data.label: Get More Calls
data.title:
5 website changes that
*bring more bookings*
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site is ready →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Make your *phone number* click-to-call
data.body: Customers are often on their phones. If they have to copy and paste your number, they will just call a competitor instead.
data.fix: Fix: Ensure your phone number is a clickable link.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Add a clear *booking button*
data.body: Don't make people hunt for a contact form. A clear button at the top of your site makes it easy for them to hire you.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 'Book Now' button to your header.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Show your *service area*
data.body: People need to know if you actually travel to their neighborhood. Listing your cities helps you rank better for local searches.
data.fix: Fix: List your city and surrounding areas on your homepage.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Show *customer reviews*
data.body: New clients want to know you are reliable. Real feedback builds trust instantly and helps you stand out from other local pros.
data.fix: Fix: Add 3-5 testimonials directly to your homepage.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Check your *mobile speed*
data.body: If your site takes too long to load on a phone, potential customers will leave before they ever see your services.
data.fix: Fix: Remove large, unoptimized images from your site.
